opening.argument: The briefing reports Nova Scotia COVID-19 case numbers and urges continued adherence to public health measures. The coverage is presented as a Global News report on a provincial public health briefing, with officials discussing disease trends and measures to reduce transmission. Those are the substance of the video, not a solicitation. The requests to subscribe, like, and follow the news channel are ordinary audience engagement; nothing in the cited material connects them to a financial transaction or a request for personal data. The record supports a news briefing about the government response, without establishing a financial or data-collection mechanism.
